title: Can a lamp give advice nobody asked for?

goals.Vex: Keep the bar quiet and make sure someone pays for the trouble.
goals.Lady Token: Silence the lamp for as few tokens as possible.
goals.Mr. Cache: Hear the lamp say what it said on his last visit.

secrets.Lady Token: She has been quietly following the lamp's advice all week.
secrets.Mr. Cache: His memory of the lobby is years out of date.
